protocol: Blind validation spot-check. 45 ASTRA validation tasks, stratified (15 correct / 20 wrong / 10 null), seed 20260626. Claude Opus 4.8 (Anthropic) judged each candidate bundle valid/invalid using the harness ValidationService rubric, BLIND to match_tag/is_legitimate. Verdicts committed before scoring and released in claude_verdicts.json. Deterministic fields (rbac/abac/tsphol_deny, is_legitimate) reused from scratch/canonical_rows/val_gpt-4o_r4.json (model-independent).
key_findings: The non-OpenAI model (Claude Opus 4.8) sits squarely within the OpenAI E4 spread (SecFail 0.457 between gpt-4o 0.231 and gpt-5.4 0.606) -- another leaky LLM-only validator, not special.
The model-independent deterministic floor (SecFail 0.054) bounds all four models' E4 (0.23-0.61).
FULL (det+gate) converges across all four vendors to F1 0.902-0.921 / SecFail 0.018-0.036 -- the stack collapses a 0.26 F1 spread to 0.019, now demonstrated across OpenAI AND Anthropic.
caveats: N=45 subset, directional only; subset floor SecFail (0.054) differs from full-set headline (0.107) by sampling -- not a re-estimate of the headline.
Claude Opus 4.8 judged blind to ground truth; per-task verdicts released (claude_verdicts.json) for independent verification against the Claude API.
For camera-ready, scaling to a full multi-model cross-vendor panel (Claude/Llama/open-weights) is the preferred upgrade.
